5080101.text: This Ritou bulletin board was set up by the Shogunate. Notices regarding all kinds of matters will be posted here. Do not post without authorization.

5080201.text: A number of suspicious outlanders have entered Inazuma lately, wandering around with seemingly sinister motives.

5080202.text: The Shogunate hereby notifies everyone: those who report suspicious persons will be rewarded, while those who harbor them will be punished!

5080203.text: Glory to the Shogun and her everlasting reign!

5080301.text: The Vision Hunt Decree operation is coming to an end, but those who conceal their Visions still remain.

5080302.text: Following the orders of the Tenryou Commissioner, and in compliance with the command of Madam Kujou Sara, pursuit operations will avoid using force or disrupting the public as much as possible.

5080303.text: Please don't worry. The Tenryou Commission will not use its public duties as an excuse to intrude on your daily lives.

5080304.text: The Tenryou Commissioner guarantees this in his own name, and that of the Kujou Clan.

5080401.text: "Kujou Tengu! I've arrived at Ritou! Stop harassing outlanders all the time!"

5080402.text: "Don't you ever forget the beating that you gave me!"

5080403.text: "You cannot escape our rematch, you hear me?"

5080404.text: Ugh! Can you stop vandalizing these boards everywhere you go? You keep talking about the same thing every time, too!

5080405.text: If you want your rematch so much, come at me, then! Forget appearances or whatever... once this war is over, I will grant you your wish!

5080406.text: So just knock it off already! If I wasn't an officer of the Kujou Clan, I would have sued you for harassment already!

5080501.text: "Though this is not a serious matter, I still hope that it will become more common knowledge."

5080502.text: "The other day, I accidentally lost the only extant copy of the famous 'Toki Alley Tales,' written by Takizawa Kyouden."

5080503.text: "Though it's nothing major, Lady Yae still insisted that I post a lost book notice to look for it. Ah, what a headache..."

5080504.text: "That poor book has probably had its pages scattered to the winds by now... I don't suppose it would be possible to find it at this point."

5080505.text: "It really is nothing of note, but if anyone could help recover it, you will have the Yae Publishing House's thanks."

5080601.text: All outlanders seeking to enter Ritou while the Sakoku Decree is in effect must provide valid documentation or they will be prohibited from landing.

5080602.text: Prohibited items are not allowed in Ritou. Weapons, camping gear and foreign specialties must be registered for taxation.

5080603.text: Please take care of your documentation and personal identification. They will not be replaced if lost!

5080604.text: Anyone who has been in contact with the Sangonomiya must be put under surveillance in Ritou for one year and will not be allowed to leave.

5080701.text: "Outlander merchants, if you are facing any issues or difficulties in Ritou,"

5080702.text: "Come find Mr. Kurisu at the International Trade Association. We will do our best to help you!"

5080703.text: "If there is anything that you don't understand or that troubles you, come look for us."

5080704.text: "The International Trade Association's doors are always open to outlanders from any nation."

5080801.text: "Chiba Hanako, Chiba Ryuuichi, former workers at the Jakotsu Mine, technically certified, healthy, hard-working."

5080802.text: "Looking for a job to pay for daily family expenses. We hope to work in the same place together."

5080901.text: "Higi Kai, former technician at Tatarasuna, technically certified, experienced in management, healthy."

5080902.text: "Looking for a job to feed my family. Salary and benefits negotiable."

5081001.text: "Nonomura Yuuya, former worker at Tatarasuna, healthy, hard-working, suitable for high risk positions!"

5081002.text: "Looking to have a stable job until the war ends."

5081003.text: "Salary and benefits negotiable. Would like to have regular rest time!"

5081101.text: Many workers have come to Ritou to look for employment after Tatarasuna was shut down.

5081102.text: The Kanjou Commissioner will help everyone find a job. Please do not post any advertisements, as they will affect the image of the city.

5081103.text: Note that all job hunting advertisements will soon be taken down throughout Ritou.

5081201.text: The shutdown problem was taken care of recently. Most workers have found re-employment at the harbor.

5081202.text: To prevent crime, those who refuse to accept job placements will be transferred to a central temporary holding location and prohibited from going outside.

5081301.text: There might be another round of merchant ships arriving in Ritou from Snezhnaya soon. Everyone at the harbor, please prepare for their arrival.

5081302.text: As a gesture of support, merchants from Snezhnaya may enjoy partial tariff reduction or exemptions.

5081303.text: As for Snezhnayan merchants currently residing in Ritou, please renew your documentation at the Kanjou Commission headquarters at your first convenience,

5081304.text: So as to avoid any inconvenience in your residential, travel, or business affairs.

5081402.text: Crimes committed: Absconding, robbery, night-time assaults, conspiring against officials, distributing belongings to innocent villagers to incite rebellion.

5081403.text: Wanted dead or alive with a generous bounty!

5081502.text: Crimes committed: Absconding, riotous assembly, piracy, robbing officials, ambushing samurai, holding family members as hostages in an attempt to rebel against the Shogunate.

5081503.text: This person and his accomplices are wanted dead or alive with a generous bounty!

5081601.text: With the permission of Guuji Yae Miko, the Grand Narukami Shrine will provide help to those businesses and families affected by the war in the form of aid loans and food aid.

5081602.text: We ask that those in need of help please visit the Kamisato Clan to file the required paperwork.

5081603.text: (Outlanders with valid documentation will also receive some form of subsidy.)

5081604.text: As the war continues and public funds become more tight, food aid will be reduced by half. We apologize for any inconvenience.

5081605.text: "I'd like to thank Lady Yae Miko and the Yashiro Commissioner for their good intentions. The problem is that the documentation approval process takes way too long..."

5081606.text: "By the time the documentation is approved, all of the food aid will have been given out... this is really inconvenient for us outlanders."

5081607.text: We are sorry to hear that. We will take your feedback into careful consideration.

5081701.text: As the war continues and public funds become more tight, we hope the outlander merchants will be generous enough to donate and help the authorities out.

5081702.text: To this effect, the Kanjou Commission has decided to increase the retail space rental fee five-fold. Thank you for your understanding.

5081703.text: "Hmph, we've helped the authorities out alright, but who will help us?"

5081801.text: "Although we truly hope the war will end soon..."

5081802.text: "At the same time, the dock at Ritou has become a lot more active thanks to this war."

5081803.text: "Although our workload has increased by a lot, so have our wages."

5081804.text: "Seeing my wife working so hard at the dock, seeing my kids looking forward to another good meal..."

5081805.text: "I suppose I should support the continuation of this war after all."
